messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Computer-assisted nonlinear optimization with interval-arithmetic verification

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square is uniquely determined (up to the square's symmetry group) by minimizing the negative of the minimum log-triangle-area via a nonlinear interior-point solver, with all 286 triangle areas as constraints, and the resulting configuration has a minimum triangle area strictly exceeding 1/55. The optimality can be rigorously verified by subdividing the configuration space into interval-arithmetic boxes and confirming via the Krawczyk operator that the KKT system of the min-area maximization has exactly one solution within the unit square's domain, and that no boundary-degenerate configuration achieves a larger minimum area."}
